text:
Nina (AE): Quick handoff — Sunrise Labs pilot -> Priya. Context: 40-seat pilot, pilot start target 2026-06-01, SSO via Okta, SOC2 required, likely ask for dedicated pool if sustained qps >60. Customer is price-sensitive; sales noted renewal risk if we can't show early cost wins.
Priya (CSM): Thanks Nina. Can you drop the runbook + any compliance docs? I'll own health tracking and kickoff.
Nina (AE): Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/deals/sunrise. Compliance: SOC2 Type II, audit log retention 12 months, they need audit export.
Omar (Solutions): I'll build enablement + workshop. Need: two sample datasets, expected peak qps, list of pilot admins for RBAC.
Nina (AE): Uploaded datasets and admin emails. Peak demo day qps ~85, baseline 20.
Jules (Support Eng): Heads-up: SAML metadata digest doesn't match ours. Also private VPC requested; need CIDR and KMS preference (cloud vs HSM). Opening infra ticket.
Nina (AE): Customer CIDR: 172.20.0.0/16. They prefer cloud KMS initially. SAML cert: <sunrise-saml.pem>.
Jules (Support Eng): CIDR overlaps internal staging range  flagged. Creating ticket RED-13001 to provision sandbox VPC and reconcile SAML.
ops-bot: Ticket RED-13001 created and routed to eng-infra.
Priya (CSM): Adding preflight items: SAML fingerprint, sandbox VPC, SOC2 evidence, audit export config. Scheduling kickoff Thurs 11:00 PT.
Omar (Solutions): For the workshop I'll prepare a 45-min demo + 30-min lab. Need non-prod API key and one replayable convo trace.
Nina (AE): Non-prod API key placeholder and a replay trace uploaded. Also called out procurement sensitivity on pricing.
Priya (CSM): Plan: weekly enablement during pilot + cost review after week 1. I'll label account "renewal-monitor" and escalate to growth if cost >10% above forecast.
Jules (Support Eng): Note: if they later require HSM KMS, procurement lead time ~5-6 weeks. Cloud KMS can be setup in ~48-72 hrs once VPC is ready. Also adding required egress IPs to ticket.
Nina (AE): Customer OK with cloud KMS for pilot.
Omar (Solutions): I'll draft a one-page cost-savings note (batching, caching, model variant) for the pilot profile. Due Fri.
Priya (CSM): Owners & immediate next steps:
- Priya: kickoff invite, health timeline, weekly check-ins, renewal-monitor label.
- Omar: enablement playbook + cost one-pager (Fri).
- Jules: RED-13001 infra ticket, SAML validation, sandbox VPC.
- Nina: confirm datasets, SAML cert, customer comms cadence.
Jules (Support Eng): RED-13001 created. Added note about CIDR overlap and required IAM role. :white_check_mark:
Nina (AE): I'll confirm procurement contact and send final dataset link.
Priya (CSM): Any blockers?
Jules (Support Eng): CIDR overlap + SAML digest mismatch are current blockers until infra resolves RED-13001.
Omar (Solutions): Waiting on replay trace verification to finalize labs.
Priya (CSM): Kickoff Thu 11:00 PT. I'll post a short recap + initial health score after the call. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
